launches.title: ClaimKit: Global R&D tax credits on autopilot
launches.tagline: Audit-ready R&D tax claims at a fraction of consultant cost
launches.body:
Hey hey! We're Rachel and Will, founders of ClaimKit.

**TL;DR:** ClaimKit uses AI + R&D tax experts to track and claim R&D tax credits on autopilot, with audit-ready claims at a fraction of what consultants charge. 7 months after launch, we serve 80+ clients across 3 countries.

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ahFVb8g983I>

The opportunity 70+ governments reward R&D spend with tax credits or cash refunds, including the US, UK, Canada, Australia, Germany, Japan and France. For tech companies that can mean \~10- 40% back on every research dollar.

**The problem:**

Proving how much expenses qualify is a compliance nightmare. CFOs and CTOs reconstruct months of engineering work from memory, dig through git logs and payroll, and hope it survives an audit. Most either overpay consultants or leave money on the table.

**The solution:**

ClaimKit plugs into the tools you already use, captures audit-ready evidence continuously, and produces consultant-level claims in a fraction of the time and cost. Every claim is reviewed by our in-house experts (ex-KPMG, PwC, BDO). For remote teams across countries and states, we also find credits you didn't know you were eligible for.

**The team:**

I'm a serial founder and ex-KPMG R&D tax, where I helped clients claim on $100M+ of R&D spend. I watched clients waste weeks reconstructing evidence and still miss credits, because nobody captured R&D as it happened. Will (ex-Google engineer) and I built ClaimKit to fix that.

**Our ask:**

* Intros to R&D teams with 50+ engineers who hate the manual claim process
* Drop me a message if you suspect you can claim in a different country but skip it because it is a hassle. 
* Feedback from anyone who's lived through R&D credit pain.

Reach us: [rachel@claimkit.co](mailto:rachel@claimkit.co) | <https://calendar.app.google/uceMQpveT7dCa4C27>
